about: A reader that runs over its place is offered its sources and every leaf its shape names besides the word it runs by — `run|package.json|dist/**` offers the manifest and the build — so a lot that moves a leaf it reads runs it again, and a leaf a view writes from what readers said is offered only when a shape names it, so no reading moves its own offer. The readers of leaves and of directories are offered as before; a capsule reader is offered the leaves it is handed.

cases.name: the tree's readers as their lines stand, passes on a copy at epoch 280

red was: exports-resolve read three after a manifest-only lot
